comparison.objective: Stand up and lift a 1 kg filament spool bimanually, then slide it squarely onto a holder rod until it touches the stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lifting and large-bore shaft alignment with a 7 mm clearance margin; it does not require striking a stabilized mandrel or recovering fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Spool is upright, threaded onto the rod, and touching its stop; further rubric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve coaxial alignment, this record tests heavy bimanual lift-and-thread insertion, whereas the candidate tests controlled notch fracture without displacing a retained coil plus four-fragment recovery.
